org.portico.lrc.services.object.data

Class RegionStore

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.lrc.services.object.data.RegionStore
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SaveRestoreTarget

    public class RegionStore
extends Object
implements SaveRestoreTarget
    This class maintains a list of all RegionInstance instances known locally.

    • Method Detail

      • addRegion

        public void addRegion(RegionInstance region)
        Adds the given RegionInstance to the store. If there is already a RegionInstance with the given handle within this store, that RegionInstance will be replaced with the one that is being added. If the given region is null, nothing will happen.

      • getRegion

        public RegionInstance getRegion(int regionHandle)
        Fetch the contained region with the supplied region handle. If no RegionInstance can be found with that handle, null is returned.

      • getRegionWeCreated

        public RegionInstance getRegionWeCreated(int regionHandle)
        This method will find the region of the given handle and if it was created by the federate this store serves, it will be returned. If the region doesn't exist, or it was created by another federate, null will be returned.

      • getRegionCreatedBy

        public RegionInstance getRegionCreatedBy(int regionHandle,
                                         int federateHandle)
        Finds the RegionInstance associated with the provided regionHandle and returns it, but *ONLY* is the federate identified by the given federateHandle was the one that created it in the first place.

        If there is no known region for the handle, or the region was created by a federate different to that identified by the federate handle, null is returned.

        Parameters:
        regionHandle - The handle of the region to find the RegionInstance for
        federateHandle - The handle of the federate we expect to have created the region
        Returns:
        The region associated with the handle, only if it was also created by the identified federete. Null if there is no region, or a different federate created it

      • removeRegion

        public RegionInstance removeRegion(int regionHandle)
        Remove and return the contained RegionInstance with the given handle. If the RegionInstance exists, it will be removed and returned. If no RegionInstance with the given handle exists, null will be returned and the store will remain unaffected.

      • removeRegion

        public RegionInstance removeRegion(RegionInstance theRegion)
        Remove and return the contained RegionInstance. If the RegionInstance exists in the store, it will be removed and returned. If the RegionInstance doesn't exist in the collection, null will be returned and the store will remain unaffected.

      • containsRegion

        public boolean containsRegion(int regionHandle)
        Returns true if the store contains a RegionInstance with the given handle, false otherwise.

      • containsRegion

        public boolean containsRegion(RegionInstance region)
        Returns true if the store contains the given RegionInstance, false otherwise.

      • containsRegion

        public boolean containsRegion(HLA13Region region)
        Returns true if the store contains the given HLA13Region, false otherwise. It will actually get the wrapped RegionInstance instance inside the HLA13Region and check using that.

      • containsRegion

        public boolean containsRegion(Java1Region region)
        Returns true if the store contains the given Java1Region, false otherwise. It will actually get the wrapped RegionInstance instance inside the Java1Region and check using that.

      • associateForUpdates

        public static void associateForUpdates(RegionInstance region,
                                       OCInstance theObject,
                                       OCMetadata objectClass,
                                       Set<Integer> attributes)
                                throws JInvalidRegionContext
        This is a convenience method that will validate the request to associate the given region with the identified attributes of the given object.
        Parameters:
        region - the region you wish to associate the attributes with
        theObject - the object instance this association applies to
        objectClass - the type of the underlyling object (NOT the discovered type)
        attributes - the set of attributes to link with the given region
        Throws:
        JInvalidRegionContext - If the region is of a different routing space to that which the FOM declares as being allowed to be associated with a specific attribute type

      • unassociateForUpdates

        public static void unassociateForUpdates(RegionInstance region,
                                         OCInstance theObject)
        Convenience method that will unassociate each of the attributes in the given object instance from the supplied region. If the attribute isn't associated with a region, or is associated with a different region, it will be left alone.
        Parameters:
        region - The region to remove all attribute/region associations for
        theObject - The object to remove all attribute/region associations from
